node.title: Re: why package definition order affect the available of package variable
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
The [doc://package] statement doesn't affect execution order: $global = "I'm in the testEnd package global version"; is executed after the testEnd::show_me() call, so $testEnd::global is still undef at that point in time.

Note that you should always [id://111088].
